body.statement: Using \(\mathsf{CensusHandle}\), determine \(d_e(G)\) for every rooted graph-query orbit with \(n\le5\) and \(k\le2\) over characteristic zero. In particular, either certify the supplied five-vertex quartic in \(A_K=S_G^{-1}(R_{\mathrm{inc}}/I_G)\) or exhibit the first strict loss between the prescribed-orientation count and the SEM coordinate degree; any strict loss must be incorporated into the recurrence sought in \(\mathrm{oeq:sharp\mbox{-}size\mbox{-}frontier}\).
body.justification: This is the bounded destructive test that can invalidate the uncorrected orientation-realization conjecture before the all-size proof is attempted.
body.gap: The five-node computations of Foygel, Draisma, and Drton classify whole graphs and selected whole-fiber degrees, not every original-edge coordinate degree under the rooted excess-arrow budget in the \(S_G\)-localized prime incidence algebra.
body.consumer: The frontier proof receives certified base cases or a concrete correction term, and fasttreeid receives a complete small-instance regression suite.
